name: Provider-Neutral Invocation Contract
description: Define a provider-neutral contract for LLM invocation that abstracts away provider-specific details into a unified request shape, response shape, and error shape. This contract serves as the core abstraction layer that all providers implement against, enabling interchangeable backend usage without per-provider code changes.
purpose: Establish a universal invocation contract that decouples application code from specific LLM providers, enabling provider interchangeability and consistent request/response handling across all backends.
acceptanceCriteria: Request shape defined with required fields: model, messages, temperature, maxTokens, stopSequences, tools, toolChoice, stream, metadata
Response shape defined with fields: id, model, provider, choices, usage, latency, error
Error shape defined with discriminated union: rate_limit, auth_error, content_policy, server_error, timeout, unknown
All shapes are TypeScript interfaces with strict typing
JSON Schema generated for each shape for runtime validation
Documentation written for each field including defaults and constraints
